email_layout_reason_workspace: You received this email because you’re a member of {workspace} on Luma.
email_layout_reason_account: You received this email because it concerns your Luma account.
email_layout_reason_invitation: You received this email because someone invited this address to a Luma workspace. If you didn’t expect it, you can ignore it.
email_layout_link_fallback: If the button doesn’t work, copy this link into your browser:
email_invitation_body: {inviter} invited you to {workspace} with the {role} role.
email_invitation_instructions: Sign in or create an account with this email address to review and accept the invitation. The link works until it expires or the invitation is revoked.
email_test_preview: Email delivery to this address works.
email_test_body: Luma can reach you at this address. The notifications you turn on for {workspace} arrive here.
email_issue_subject: An issue in {workspace} needs your attention
email_issue_preview: Open the issue to see the evidence and decide what happens next.
email_issue_body: An issue in {workspace} is waiting for an approval, manual work or a review of an outcome Luma couldn’t confirm. Open it to see the evidence and decide what happens next.
email_connection_subject: A connection in {workspace} needs your attention
email_connection_preview: Luma may not be able to read or change data through it.
email_connection_body: A connected system in {workspace} isn’t responding reliably, or its access was revoked. Until it’s fixed, Luma may not be able to read or change data through it.
email_support_request_subject: Luma support asks for access to {workspace}
email_support_request_preview: Read-only access for {duration}. Nothing happens until you approve.
email_support_request_heading: Luma support asks for read-only access
email_support_request_body: Luma support asks to view {workspace} read-only for {duration}, to investigate a problem. Nothing happens until you approve.
email_support_request_duration: {days, plural, one {24 hours} other {{days, number} days}}
email_support_view_heading: Luma support started a read-only view
email_support_view_body: Luma support is viewing {workspace} as {member}. Support can’t change anything in this view, and every page they open appears in Activity.
email_support_emergency_subject: Luma support used emergency access to {workspace}
email_support_emergency_preview: Read-only, without prior approval, for a security or legal reason.
email_support_emergency_body: Luma support viewed {workspace} read-only as {member} without prior approval, for a security or legal reason. Support couldn’t change anything.
email_support_inspection_preview: 30 minutes of read-only access to {workspace}’s records. Nothing happens until you approve.
email_support_inspection_heading: Luma support asks to inspect your workspace
email_support_inspection_body: Luma support asks for 30 minutes of read-only access to {workspace}’s records, to investigate a problem. Nothing happens until someone who manages Luma support access approves.
email_support_inspection_limits: Inspection shows members, connections, sync health and access history. It can’t change anything, and it appears in Activity. The request lapses after 24 hours.
email_support_inspection_emergency_subje: Luma support opened emergency access to {workspace}
email_support_inspection_emergency_body: For {category}, Luma support opened 30 minutes of read-only access to {workspace}’s records without prior approval. Support can’t change anything, and the access appears in Activity.
email_password_reset_preview: The link expires in 15 minutes and works once.
email_password_reset_body: Use this link to choose a new Luma password. It expires 15 minutes after your request and works once.
email_password_reset_ignore: If you didn’t request this, ignore this email. Your password stays the same.
email_password_changed_preview: If this wasn’t you, reset your password now.
email_password_changed_body: The password for your Luma account was changed.
email_password_changed_warning: If you didn’t make this change, reset your password from the sign-in page and contact Luma support.
email_verification_preview: Confirm this address to finish creating your account.
email_verification_body: Confirm that this address belongs to you to finish creating your Luma account. The link works for 24 hours.
email_verification_ignore: If you didn’t create a Luma account, ignore this email. Nobody can sign in with this address until it is confirmed.
email_factor_passkey_subject: A passkey was added to your Luma account
email_factor_authenticator_subject: Two-factor authentication was turned on for your Luma account
email_factor_preview: If this wasn’t you, reset your password now.
email_factor_passkey_body: A new passkey can now sign in to your Luma account.
email_factor_authenticator_body: An authenticator app now confirms sign-ins to your Luma account.
email_factor_warning: If you didn’t make this change, reset your password from the sign-in page, remove the passkey or authenticator app under Settings › Security, and contact Luma support.
email_account_scheduled_subject: Your Luma account is scheduled for deletion
email_account_scheduled_preview: Contact Luma support before {date} to keep it.
email_account_scheduled_heading: Your account is scheduled for deletion
email_account_scheduled_body: Luma support scheduled your Luma account for deletion. You can no longer sign in.
email_account_scheduled_erase: On {date} your account and the personal data linked to it will be erased permanently. Workspaces you belong to keep their records of your work, shown as a former member.
email_account_scheduled_keep: To keep your account, contact Luma support before then.
email_account_restored_body: Luma support cancelled the deletion of your Luma account. Your workspaces and roles are as they were before.
email_account_erased_subject: Your Luma account has been deleted
email_account_erased_preview: Your account and the personal data linked to it are being erased.
email_account_erased_body: Luma is erasing your account and the personal data linked to it now. You can’t sign in again, and the account can’t be restored.
email_account_erased_records: Workspaces you belonged to keep their records of your work, shown as a former member.
email_account_inspection_subject: Luma support asks to inspect your account
email_account_inspection_preview: 30 minutes of read-only access. Nothing happens until you approve.
email_account_inspection_heading: Luma support asks to inspect your account
email_account_inspection_body: Luma support asks for 30 minutes of read-only access to your account details, to investigate a problem. Nothing happens until you approve in Settings › Security.
email_account_inspection_limits: Inspection shows your workspaces and roles, whether two-factor authentication is on, your active sessions and your security activity. It never shows your password or sign-in secrets. The request lapses after 24 hours.
email_account_inspection_emergency_subje: Luma support opened emergency access to your account
email_account_inspection_emergency_body: For {category}, Luma support opened 30 minutes of read-only access to your account details without prior approval. It appears in your security activity. Times are in UTC.
email_morning_brief_preview: Your decisions, ongoing work and independently verified results.
email_morning_brief_window: Verified results: {start} to {end}. Attention and unresolved cases describe the current snapshot.
email_morning_brief_honesty: Results count verified cases, not actions or SKUs. Executed changes awaiting verification remain unresolved. Recorded cases do not establish complete provider coverage.
email_morning_brief_partial: Some decision sources or measurement classifications are incomplete. Known figures describe the available records; automatic outcomes are not inferred.
email_protection_placed: Luma placed stock holds for {store} because its ERP stock sync stalled. Open the incident for every held and unprotected SKU.
email_protection_partial: Some stock holds for {store} could not be confirmed. Luma keeps uncertain writes for reconciliation and does not resend them.
email_protection_escalated: Stock holds for {store} reached their time limit. Review the incident to release them or keep them longer.
email_protection_released: Stock protection for {store} has ended. Review the verified releases, outside changes and incident summary.
email_workspace_closure_reminder_subject: {workspace} will be deleted in a week
email_workspace_closure_preview: Contact Luma support before {date} to keep it.
email_workspace_closure_scheduled_body: {workspace} is closed. On {date} Luma deletes its data.
email_workspace_closure_reminder_body: {workspace} is closed, and Luma deletes its data on {date}.
email_workspace_closure_scope: This removes orders, stock, customers, messages, issues, workflows and every other record in the workspace. Luma keeps its log of actions taken in the workspace for a limited time afterwards. Deleted data can’t be restored.
email_workspace_closure_keep: To keep {workspace}, ask Luma support to reopen it before {date}.
